why: The session's load-bearing evidence (refcv4b - refcv3 -0.1444 [-0.1647,-0.1227], the trivial-control ties, os_navzero +0.1054, the four metric families) rested on dumps living ONLY in C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\...\<session-id>\scratchpad\. The operating standard is explicit: an artifact on one disk is NOT done. A scratchpad is worse than one disk - it is a temp directory keyed to a session id.
precedent_followed: TanitAD Research Lab/Architecture & Inference/Research/2026-09-06-refcv4b-navpred/raw/navpred_dump.tgz (13,048,687 B) and navflip_dump.tgz (14,804,062 B) - tarballs banked into a package raw/. This package ADDS the sidecar those two lack.

verification_protocol.md5_both_ends: md5 computed on the LOCAL tar and again on the REPO copy; recorded only on match.
verification_protocol.content_not_size: This mount has produced correct-size ALL-NUL files. Every banked tar was asserted on CONTENT: non-zero bytes in the first 64 KiB.
verification_protocol.discriminating_control: A genuine all-NUL file (262,144 B) was created and passed through the SAME non-zero counter IN THE SAME RUN. It read 0 non-zero bytes while every banked tar read >65,000. Without this the '>0' assertion proves nothing.
verification_protocol.deep_assert: For every dump the BANKED (repo) tar was re-opened, its manifest.json parsed, and an ep*.npz loaded with numpy - asserting g finite, nonzero_frac > 0.5, |sum| > 1.
verification_protocol.identity_from_manifest_not_name: Directory names were NOT trusted. Identity comes from manifest.model.ckpt / .step / .n_anchors / .cfg.core.anchors and the arm key set, PLUS a numeric discriminator over all 141 episodes: ground truth `g` must be bit-identical across dumps (same windows) while the model prediction `os` must DIFFER (different model).
verification_protocol.inconclusive_never_absent: Any unreadable byte range would have been reported INCONCLUSIVE; none occurred.
